target_customer: Business and operations teams that work in spreadsheets and need live data from SaaS tools and databases
problem: Teams export CSVs from SaaS and databases into spreadsheets that go stale. Actiondesk gave a spreadsheet interface connected to live data sources.

founders.name: Jonathan Parisot
founders.background_notes: YC page: later a product leader at Datadog after the acquisition.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connectors to many data sources plus a spreadsheet engine with lookups and pivot tables, per Datadog's description.

defensibility.rationale: Connector breadth helps but Google Sheets and BI vendors could add live data connectors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Datadog acquired Actiondesk, announced 2023-11-13, terms undisclosed, to bring spreadsheet features into its platform.

market_need_then: Launched on Product Hunt in August 2019 as Actiondesk for Google Sheets, importing data with hourly refresh. Spend data not found.

brand_strength.rationale: No source shows press, community or founder commentary about the brand itself, so no brand strength can be shown.

outcome_analysis: Actiondesk started in YC Summer 2019 as a Google Sheets add-on for live data, then became its own spreadsheet. It raised a 3.9M seed in May 2022 and was bought by Datadog in November 2023 with terms undisclosed. The pattern is a modest capital path ending in a strategic sale, but the price is unknown.
